The '''Okuda Shogunate''' was a shogunate listed among the defunct nations of the Avant world.

The source table gives its formation as 1282 and its dissolution as 1854. A separate Okuda source page describes post-1994 Okuda material, but this 1994-back draft does not treat those later events as part of the current historical pass.

== Canon Limits ==

Do not conflate the Okuda Shogunate with later Okuda political material until a dedicated source review confirms continuity, succession, or revival claims.
